title: Genesis 1:1-3 — the 15th, 26th, 31st and 86th letters of the Bible are alef
summary: Genesis 1:1-3 in Hebrew with the key alef (א) letters picked out in blue and numbered 15 and 26 (in verse 1), 31 (in verse 2) and 86 (in verse 3), ending with the statement that the 15th, 26th, 31st and 86th letters of the Bible are alef.

text.text: 1 בראשית ברא אלהים את השמים ואת הארץ׃
2 והארץ היתה תהו ובהו וחשך על־פני
תהום ורוח אלהים מרחפת על־פני המים׃
The 15th, 26th, 31st, 86th letters of the Bible are א.

letters.meaning: the 15th, 26th, 31st and 86th letters of the Bible

numbers.note: 15th letter of the Bible is alef (the א of את in Genesis 1:1)
26th letter of the Bible is alef (the א of הארץ in Genesis 1:1)
31st letter of the Bible is alef (the א of והארץ in Genesis 1:2)
86th letter of the Bible is alef (the א of אלהים in Genesis 1:3)

uncertain: Which individual alefs are blue in the verses is partly judged by eye; the slide's own statement names the 15th, 26th, 31st and 86th letters.
